import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/seva_invoice_register_uncalculated.xlsx'
header_idx = 3
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Invoice Register', header=header_idx)

# Keep only rows where Invoice ID looks like SEVA-25-
mask = df['Invoice ID'].astype(str).str.startswith('SEVA-25-')
df_clean = df[mask].copy()

# Ensure numeric
df_clean['Quantity'] = pd.to_numeric(df_clean['Quantity'], errors='coerce')
df_clean['Unit Rate (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(df_clean['Unit Rate (INR)'], errors='coerce')

# Compute line amount
df_clean['Line Amount'] = df_clean['Quantity'] * df_clean['Unit Rate (INR)']

# Filter for Community Nutrition and Odisha
filtered = df_clean[(df_clean['Programme'] == 'Community Nutrition') & (df_clean['State'] == 'Odisha')]
print("Filtered rows:")
print(filtered[['Invoice ID','Expense Date','Quantity','Unit Rate (INR)','Line Amount','District','State','Programme']])

total = filtered['Line Amount'].sum()
print("Total:", total)
print("Count:", len(filtered))
